en.headline: Watchdog issues strong advice over TVB health programme
en.dek: The Communications Authority upheld 10 complaints about claims on a March TVB Plus show and urged the station to follow the programme code.
body: The Communications Authority has upheld 10 complaints about a TVB Plus programme broadcast in March and issued a strong advice to Television Broadcasts, urging it to comply strictly with the relevant provisions of the television programme code.

The complaints concerned health advice given by a doctor appearing on the programme 《醫啲阿媽都唔知》. Complainants said some remarks were inaccurate and misleading, including claims that vegetables and fibre are not necessary for human survival, growth or health, and that drinking more water relieves constipation only in patients who are severely dehydrated. They said the advice conflicted with public-health guidance from the World Health Organization and the Centre for Health Protection.

The authority said the programme was presented as clarifying misconceptions and setting out health facts, so statements of fact were subject to the accuracy requirement. It found that the doctor's summary did not cite the basis or research for the advice, and could mislead viewers into thinking that eating vegetables causes constipation.

The authority said it accepted that TVB and the host were not medical professionals, but found the host had not made reasonable efforts to ensure the information was accurate. A disclaimer at the end of the programme did not remove the licensee's duty to meet the accuracy requirement, it said. The case involved a matter of significant public interest with a potential effect on public health.

zh.headline: 通訊局就TVB健康節目發強烈勸諭
zh.dek: 通訊局接獲10宗投訴，指TVB Plus三月播出的節目含可能不準確及有誤導風險的健康建議，裁定投訴成立。
body: 通訊事務管理局就無綫電視TVB Plus台今年三月播出的節目，接獲10宗投訴，裁定投訴成立，向無綫發出強烈勸諭，並敦促嚴格遵守《電視節目守則》相關規定。
投訴涉及節目嘉賓、一名醫生提出的部分健康建議，包括「蔬菜及纖維並非人類生存、成長或健康所必需」，以及「增加水分攝取量來緩解便秘，僅對嚴重脫水的便秘患者有效」。投訴人認為這些說法不準確、具誤導性，並有違世界衞生組織及衞生防護中心的公共衞生指引。
通訊局表示，節目明確定位為澄清誤解並呈現與健康相關的事實，因此屬醫療及健康節目，事實陳述須符合準確性要求。該醫生總結建議時未提及依據和研究，可能誤導觀眾以為進食蔬菜會導致便秘。
通訊局理解無綫及主持不具備醫療專業知識，但認為主持未作出合理努力確保資訊準確。節目結尾的免責聲明不能免除持牌人遵守準確性要求的責任。局方指，有關內容涉及重大公眾利益，對公眾健康有潛在影響。
